'''challenger Ripoff of yavinite Yeah… (PROFIT)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[challenger]]
* '''Published:''' 27 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif|label=You Can Either Profit By This...}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Profit challenger LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Seeking An Audience (V), Princess Leia (V), Escape Pod (V), Civil Disorder (V), Flash Of Insight (V), For Luck (V), Imperial Atrocity (V), Bright Hope (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the deck.

* 1x {{CardLink|Don't Do That Again (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-dontdothatagain.gif|label=Don't Do That Again}}

'Ten Shields based on meta (include DDTA)': only Don't Do That Again named.

== Notes ==

* Han Solo is the captured starting Han under Profit (printed Premiere card).
* Original-era (V) slips: Seeking An Audience/Princess Leia x2/Civil Disorder/Imperial Atrocity/Bright Hope (VS6), Escape Pod (VS2), Flash Of Insight (VS5), For Luck (VS3).
* Posted 'Revo' dested Revolution; 'Alter (PRE)' the Premiere Alter; 'H1 war room' Home One: War Room; 'Y4 massassi war room' Yavin 4: Massassi War Room.

== Strategy ==

First TRFCM, then SFCM, now PFCM : ). I’m really stuck on this FCM thing, but anyhoo, it plays like TRM, basically. Download Threeps, move to Aud Chamber, DDTA A Gift on him, beat on aliens. Start CD(V) against Combat or Senate, For Luck (V) against Walkers or CCF. Since I can download both Leia and Chewie, I obviously play Protector. When you need the retrieval, drop someone to the Aud Chamber to free Han for the 10. What can I say? TRM.
